findings.passage: As the District 50 Representative in the NC House, I will rise up, speak out, and, as the late John Lewis said, “get in good trouble” to protect and assure our right to the ballot and our right for representation.
findings.note: From her 2022 Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey answer on key campaign messages (first message: the right to vote and the right to representation). It does not mention ID or citizenship rules.

Listed among the No votes on the House vote to override the Governor's veto of S747, Elections Law Changes. The bill text includes photo-ID cross references (G.S. 163-166.16) alongside observer, same-day registration and other changes, so it is election law in general rather than a voter ID bill alone.
subjects: voter ID at the polls (cross references only)

places: in scope: Ballotpedia (https://ballotpedia.org/Renee_Price) says she is on the Nov 3 2026 general ballot for NC House District 50 after winning the March 3 2026 primary
